propositions: Convergence tests that re-derive the external effect side using the same helpers as the code under test remain green when the send path drifts, defeating the test's purpose.
A convergence test oracle must capture the real external effect from the production call site (with only irreducible boundaries stubbed), never re-derive it by recomposing helpers.

The defective shape (re-derived oracle) and sanctioned shape (captured oracle) are syntactically identical; distinguishing them requires intent analysis, making automated lint detection infeasible without unacceptable false positives.

The concrete convergence defect (stale truncate_comment_body model and re-derived fit_preserving_marker composition) is fixed by commit 103729e90c; what remains is documenting the rule and making it discoverable to future test authors.
The capture-don't-re-derive rule must be recorded in the shared test-design standard and synced byte-identically across all skill copies to serve as authoring guidance.

No mechanical lint will be added because the rule is an intent-based design principle, not a syntactic pattern, and legitimate characterization tests are indistinguishable from defective ones by inspection alone.
